name: D.C. III ~Da Capo III~ With You
original_name: D.C.III With You ～ダ・カーポIII～ ウィズユー
source:
This is the fandisc for D.C.III R X-rated and D.C.III P.P., with stories in both Kazamidori and Hatsunejima. There are after stories for the five heroines from Kazamidori and an if story in Hatsunejima where Kiyotaka could see the girls’ dreams, there’s also 3 new scenarios for Shiki, Sumomo and Mikoto.

[From [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2016/09/27/september-2016-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
这是D.C.III R X级和D.C.III P.P. 的同人光盘，故事发生在风翠和初音岛。其中有风绿五位女主角的后续故事，以及清隆可以看到女孩们梦想的初音岛的if故事，还有志木、相扑和美琴的3个新场景。

[来自[url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2016/09/27/september-2016-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri！[/url]]
